content.value_statement: Temporal workflows can fail in subtle ways when determinism, retries, and activities are designed poorly. This skill guides Python SDK workflow design, testing, and production operations.
actual_capabilities: Guides Temporal Python worker setup, task queues, workflow registration, and activity registration.
Explains deterministic workflow rules for time, random values, external calls, and versioning.
Helps design activities, retries, timeouts, heartbeats, signals, queries, and child workflows.
Covers testing with time skipping, mocked activities, replay checks, and integration validation.
Summarizes deployment concerns, monitoring, worker scaling, graceful shutdown, and task queue design.
limitations: It provides guidance and review support; it does not run Temporal services.
It does not replace official Temporal documentation for version-specific SDK changes.
It assumes users can provide workflow goals, data models, and infrastructure constraints.
It does not guarantee production readiness without tests and operational validation.

use_cases.title: Design Durable Business Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan Temporal workflows for payments, fulfillment, approvals, or other long-running business processes.

use_cases.title: Review Worker Operations
use_cases.description: Evaluate worker deployment, task queues, graceful shutdown, observability, and scaling practices.

use_cases.title: Plan Workflow Test Coverage
use_cases.description: Create test strategies for activities, replay checks, time skipping, compensation paths, and integration flows.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Basics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner orientation before using Temporal Python.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how Temporal Python workflows, activities, workers, task queues, signals, and queries fit together for my project.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn a business process into a durable workflow plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Temporal Python workflow for this process: [describe steps]. Include activities, retries, timeouts, signals, queries, and compensation.

prompt_templates.title: Review Reliability Risks
prompt_templates.scenario: Check an existing design before implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Temporal Python workflow design for determinism, idempotency, retry policy, timeout coverage, and activity boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for a service near launch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Temporal Python deployment plan for worker scaling, observability, replay testing, versioning, graceful shutdown, and operational failure modes.

output_examples.input: Design an order fulfillment workflow with payment, inventory, shipment, and refund compensation.
output: A workflow boundary plan with payment, inventory, and shipment activities.
A compensation sequence for refund, stock release, and shipment cancellation.
Retry, timeout, signal, and query recommendations for each stage.

output_examples.input: Review a worker deployment plan for three task queues and mixed async and blocking activities.
output: A task queue and worker sizing review.
Guidance for executor use with blocking libraries.
Operational checks for shutdown, metrics, tracing, and queue lag.

output_examples.input: Create a test plan for a month-long approval workflow.
output: Activity mocks for approval, timeout, rejection, and escalation paths.
Replay and integration checks for release confidence.

best_practices: Keep workflow logic deterministic and move external I/O into activities.
Configure timeouts, retries, and non-retryable errors for every activity.
Validate changes with unit, integration, and replay tests before deployment.
anti_patterns: Calling external APIs directly from workflow code.
Running blocking libraries inside async activities without an executor.
Deploying workers without registered workflows, task queues, and graceful shutdown.

faq.question: Does this skill write Temporal Python code?
faq.answer: It can help design and review code, but generated code still needs local tests and project-specific validation.

faq.question: Can it help with Temporal testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers time skipping, activity mocks, integration tests, replay checks, and failure injection planning.

faq.question: Does it support production operations?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides guidance for worker scaling, graceful shutdown, monitoring, tracing, and task queue design.

faq.question: Is it only for microservices?
faq.answer: No. It also applies to batch pipelines, human approvals, durable entities, and long-running business processes.

faq.question: Can it diagnose a live Temporal cluster?
faq.answer: It can guide analysis using logs, metrics, histories, and configuration that you provide.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
